# Built-in help for every tool {#sec-tool-help}

Each FUSION2 tool prints its own list of options when run with `/?`,
`-h`, or `--help`. This chapter reproduces that output for all 15 tools.
`build.ps1` captures it from the freshly built tools on every build, so it
always matches the release this manual ships with. @sec-cli-options
explains the options in more detail. The `/class` and `/return` options
that appear under many tools are described once in
@sec-point-filtering.
